paragraphs.text: Mira and Tau were a pair of Kor hookslingers from Ondu who hired themselves out as guides across the Teeth of Akoum .

Mira and Tau were supposedly hookmasters of unparalleled skill, renowned for their breathtaking technique of reining in hedrons . They led dozens of expeditions through the rubble of the Sky Ruin , rappelled to the bottom of the bottomless shaft , and watch out for each other and their clients. They were hired by Sachir to guide Chandra Nalaar across the Teeth of Akoum to Anowon 's camp for two gold coins, but during their trek, they and Chandra were attacked by a jagwasp swarm , and Mira and Tau were killed.
